## About
We are a full service auto care business in Lake Buena Vista, working on cars and trucks for drivers around Orlando, Kissimmee and the Disney area.
Bill, the owner, and his team keep things down to earth. Reviewers have written about fair prices, quick work, and the team taking time to explain what is wrong and what to watch for later.
We are open weekdays. Give the shop a call and tell us what your car is doing. We have a 4.8 rating on Google from 573 reviews.

## Services
- Full service auto care: Repair and maintenance for your vehicle, right here in Lake Buena Vista.
- Car and truck repair: We work on both cars and trucks.

## FAQ
Q: Where is the shop?
A: On State Road 535, roughly half a mile south of Interstate 4, in Lake Buena Vista.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 9 am to 5 pm. We are closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: How do I reach you?
A: Call the shop at (407) 938-9345.
